annotations.title: Propose moving a memory to another project

description: PROPOSE that a memory belongs in a different project — you never move it yourself. Moving changes WHO SEES IT: leaving a team project removes it from the team, and going from a personal project to a shared one exposes it. So this only queues the change for the human's review. Use the #handle from the read.

memory.description: #handle of the memory, from a read

project.description: Slug of the project the memory is in TODAY

target.description: Slug of the project you believe it belongs to

why.description: Why it belongs there and not here — the human decides on this sentence
